title: Grade 3 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #14

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected surah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Selected surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected surah.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Early life of the prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Early life of the prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Early life of the prophet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Early life of the prophet has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Early life of the prophet.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Honesty? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Honesty.
   B. Use Hadith on:Honesty to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Honesty with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on:Honesty has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: Respect? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on: Respect has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: Respect with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: Respect.
   D. Use Hadith on: Respect to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Believe in? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Believe in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Believe in has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Believe in to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Believe in.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   D. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: responsibility? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on: responsibility to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on: responsibility has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: responsibility.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: responsibility with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.

12. Which response best shows understanding of care for plants? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing care for plants.
   B. Say care for plants has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of care for plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use care for plants to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain care for plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. C — Apply the teaching of Selected surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A — Apply the teaching of Early life of the prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Honesty with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on: Respect with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Apply the teaching of Believe in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

10. D — Apply the teaching of Hadith on: responsibility with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of care for plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Environment; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of care for plants; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
